structuredContent.score_scope: Equal-weight technical heuristic over checked criteria only; not a judgment of the person or a guarantee of acceptance.

criteria.label: Resolution and print suitability
criteria.threshold: pass: short >=1200, long >=1500; warn: short >=600, long >=750
criteria.tip: Pixel dimensions support digital applications and high-resolution printing.

criteria.label: Aspect ratio
criteria.tip: A classic portrait fits CV templates; a square suits professional networks and round or square frames.

criteria.label: File size and format
criteria.threshold: service limit 8,000,000 bytes; JPEG/PNG full decode; no platform upload limit claimed
criteria.tip: Keep an original copy and export JPEG or PNG within the destination upload limit.

criteria.label: Brightness and exposure
criteria.threshold: fail: mean <26% or >84%, dark clip >28%, bright clip >32%; warn: mean <35% or >76%, dark >16%, bright >20%
criteria.tip: Balanced midtones without disruptive highlight or shadow clipping.

criteria.label: Contrast and dynamic range
criteria.threshold: fail: std <22 or spread <70; warn: std <32 or spread <105 or std >84
criteria.tip: Low tonal depth can look hazy. Clean the camera lens and avoid backlighting.

criteria.label: Color cast and white balance
criteria.threshold: fail: red-blue >38 or max deviation >28; warn: red-blue >24 or <-16 or max deviation >19
criteria.tip: Color channels are balanced without a strong artificial color cast.

criteria.label: Background calmness at border
criteria.tip: Few hard contrast edges at the border keep attention on the subject.

criteria.label: Sharpness (experimental)
criteria.threshold: recommendation on sampled grid: pass >=100; warn >=30
criteria.tip: Inspect eyes and clothing edges at original size; use stable focus and avoid motion blur. Texture can inflate this heuristic; it cannot prove focus.

criteria.label: Face size and framing
criteria.tip: No reliable face detector is used. Manually check head and shoulders, eyes near the upper third and sufficient space around the head.

notes: Pixel metrics use an Images binding resize to a maximum 128 px long side. Original dimensions, format and byte size are used for header checks. Sharpness detects coarse blur only; resizing removes fine focus detail. No JPEG DC/AC coefficient analysis is performed. Re-export upright; orientation and color handling can differ between local and production resizing.
